execution: 5 local seeds against the committed black-box protocol
decoder_access: states before/after, operation labels/control arguments, timestamps; decoder does not read hidden organism constants

decoded_equations.free_phase_dynamics: dphi_i/dt ~= K * sum_j W_ij sin(phi_j-phi_i) + zero-mean bounded residual
decoded_equations.pair_growth: delta_w ~= eta * exp(-0.5 * ((wrapped_phase_difference-target)/sigma)^2), applied symmetrically to W_ij and W_ji
decoded_equations.pruning: W <- (1-prune_rate) W; then entries below threshold are set to zero

interpretation.positive: With explicit state access and clean intervention boundaries, the decoder recovered the central P-KAS core constants and functional forms to near numerical precision.
interpretation.scope_limit: This is a deliberately easy calibration. The decoder is told which operation occurred and receives target_relation for growth. It has not yet discovered the higher-level SAT adapter, clause-selection policy, or a hidden equation language from raw trajectories alone.
interpretation.next_attack: Remove operation labels, mix free/grow/prune transitions into one trace, and ask the decoder to discover regimes before fitting equations.
